basic_info.description: Price Reduction! Excellent building - soft story retrofit completed, fire alarm system upgraded. Elegant and timeless, this Marina-style 12 unit building in Cow Hollow has been beautifully maintained, while retaining its original charm.  The units are large studios -  all light, bright and airy, with alcove windows and lovely original built-in cabinetry.  The common areas are gorgeous, with Art Deco features from 1925, including beautiful polished floors, coffered ceilings and other period touches.  Tenants love the location - a short walk to Marina Green, Crissy Field and Fisherman's Wharf.  Not to mention only two blocks from shops and dining on Union, Chestnut and Lombard Streets.   There is a garage in the main building off Greenwich Street and a separate garage structure with 7 parking spaces in the rear of this unique lot accessible via Gough, Lombard, and Greenwich Streets. There are two separate storage areas on the ground floor.  In the same family for almost 80 years, this property offers a unique opportunity to own a stunning piece of San Francisco history.
